title: qa: a weekly runner for the published skills' existing eval cases (subscription login, with- and no-skill arms), and the eval lane's weekly line
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgh1zkZzDXL36ckWAG

立卡门类别：④ 协调节点的子单，承父单 objectstack-ai/objectstack#34659（MCP 二期与问数专题）；#34691 裁定后的执行卡，⛔ 不是认领。
Ruling: S2 A, #34691 comment 6943116536, option text verbatim 「四张全部 A」 — 「#34691 四问都按推荐；p3 标准写进规则并放宽 4 行；查岗规则改一行；旧标签保留、改 ROADMAP 一句。」, recorded as "the skills' existing eval cases are run on a weekly schedule, and the skills are iterated from those readings". Record 6943107981 adds "with a no-skill arm, weekly and on the touched skill; a skill fix is accepted when its failing case passes".

## 维护者速读

- **做什么**：一个运行器，用订阅登录的 Claude Code 跑已发布技能里现成的 209 个评测用例，按用例自带的 must_contain / must_not_contain 机械打分，带技能、不带技能各一臂；评测席章程加一行每周一轮。
- **为什么**：这些用例从没被拿去问过模型，唯一的机械检查只覆盖 objectui 的 34 个；技能教错只能等客户撞上。不进 CI、不拦合并、不用 API 计费密钥。
- **需要你做的**：说一句技能评测分数能否进本仓 `eval-run` 记录：章程现只许场景卡记录带全分（`eval.md:34`）。

## 现状 (objectstack `origin/main` f6f5b50a05, read 2026-11-17)

- `skills/*/evals/*.json`: 26 files, 11 bundles, 209 cases (#34691 counted 208 at `a0326b06`); each has `prompt`, `expected_output`, empty `files`, `assertions` (792 `must_contain`, 378 `must_not_contain`).
- Nothing sends them to a model. `must_contain` is read only by `ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs`, `check-skill-examples.mjs` and a test.
- That token check covers objectui only (`ui/scripts/skill-bundle-root.mjs:78-83`; `--list`: 1 bundle, 11 files, 34 evals): 175 cases are not token-checked.
- A subscription-only guard exists: `packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/driver.ts:169` `API_BILLING_ENV`, `:196` `subscriptionOnlyEnv`, `:208-210` refuses no login or an API-key login.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/eval.md`: weekly scenario round (`:7`); scope ①–④ has no skills round (`:11-15`); the seat opens no PR (`:31`); territory `packages/qa/` (`:39`). Records: one `eval-run` issue a round (`.claude/skills/scenario-eval/SKILL.md` §5). Seat vacant (#34632 D9).

## 要做的

- Runner (devx) under `packages/qa/`, importing that guard, never copying it:
  - each case by `claude -p` in a fresh temp dir: with-skill arm (bundle in `.claude/skills/`, workspace or a named `@objectstack/skills` version, `Skill` allowed) and no-skill arm; no MCP server;
  - pass = all `must_contain` present, no `must_not_contain`; `--repeats N`; `--skills a,b` for a touched skill;
  - record JSON in a git-ignored `--out`; per bundle: pass rate per arm, with-skill failures, cases where no-skill ≥ with-skill;
  - `--self-test` that can fail; `--dry-run`; README: login, cost, one round's time.
- Charter line in `eval.md` (`:7` and scope ⑤): the skills' eval cases, weekly, through the runner on the subscription; one `eval-run` a round; a with-skill failure goes to `domain:skills` as a `finding`. No issue number, date or quotation (`pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`).

## 不做的

- A CI job or merge gate; new or edited cases; API-billed runs; the Routine (the eval seat's); dataset graders (#34687).

## 验收

- One round, 209 cases × 2 arms, on the subscription; time and summary posted here.
- Refuses to start with `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` set (test); `--self-test` reds on a broken grader.

Governed: `eval.md` is `.claude/**`, Tier S in objectstack (`scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs:1376`): lands on a PASS `## Contract review` for the head, checks green. Own PR, after the runner lands.

Reader: `domain:devx` (runner) · seat 3 area o3-F; the charter line is seat 3's.
Blocked-by: none.
Dedupe: `gh api -X GET search/issues -f q='repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue skill evals runner weekly'` → 6 (#34691, #34632, #33785, seat posts; none this). `… "evals" skills runner in:title` → 0.
